personality_one_liner: A highly structured, professional management command center rooted in iOS-native clarity, providing trustworthy, high-contrast visibility into contracts and office operations.

spacing.rule: Maintain iOS-native generous breathing room. Use logical properties (paddingStart, marginEnd) instead of physical (paddingLeft) to support RTL automatically. Never leave orphan elements in grids.

do's: Use blur on bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it
Use blur on sticky headers over scrolling content
Use blur for floating action buttons (FAB) over brandTertiary tint
Add a frosted overlay on the client profile cover banner
dont's: Never apply glass to standard list rows, form inputs, or standard cards
Avoid stacking more than 2 glass surfaces on screen at once

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level command center showing KPIs and urgently expiring contracts.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for KPI cards, spinner for list
states.empty: N/A - KPIs show 0, empty state illustration for expiring contracts list
states.error: Card showing 'Failed to load data' with a 'Retry' button

screens.layout: Header with office logo/greeting -> 2-col Grid for KPI cards (Total Contracts, Subscriptions, Revenue) -> 'Expiring Soon' section header -> Vertical list of Client Cards (with orange warning badges). FAB at bottom to quickly Add Contract.

screens.name: Clients (Contracts Index)
screens.purpose: Unified list of all clients, split by Cleaning vs. Security.

states.empty: Illustration + 'No clients found' + 'Add Client' primary CTA

screens.layout: Sticky Header with Search/Filter bar -> Segmented Control (Cleaning | Security) -> Vertical scrolling list of Client Cards (Status Badge, Name, Next Renewal Date). Bottom sticky CTA or FAB to add a new client.

screens.name: Account Statement (Client Details)
screens.purpose: Detailed view of a client/employee, their balance, and transaction history.

states.empty: Cover loaded, but empty state for transaction list

screens.layout: Cover image (abstract building) with gradient scrim -> Overlaid Client Info (Logo/Initials, Name, Status) -> Balance & Revenue Summary Card -> 'Transactions' section header -> Vertical list of payments/invoices. Floating action button to 'Export PDF'.

screens.name: Employees
screens.purpose: Directory of staff grouped by their role.
screens.layout: Search bar -> Vertical list of Employee Cards. Each card has an Avatar, Name, and Role Tag (Cleaning/Security) in brandTertiary. FAB to Add Employee.

screens.name: Settings
screens.layout: Vertical list grouped by sections: 'Office Info', 'Management' (Archive, Reports, Backup), 'Preferences' (Language, Theme). Use tinted icon containers (brandTertiary rounded squares) for each setting row's leading icon.

instructions_to_main_agent: RTL FIRST: Arabic is the primary language. Use React Native's I18nManager and ALWAYS use logical properties (marginStart, paddingEnd, alignItems: 'flex-start' which maps to right in RTL).
DARK MODE INVERSION: For dark mode, map surface to #121212, surfaceSecondary to #1E1E1E, and surfaceInverse to #EFEFEF. Ensure text contrasts are WCAG compliant.
NO BLUE/PURPLE: We are strictly using Moss Green (#1F4A38) as the brand identity. Success is #287C49, Warning is #C26510, Info is #4A5568. Do not use blue or indigo anywhere.
TYPOGRAPHY: 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic' is chosen as it perfectly handles both Arabic and English characters in a modern, clean geometry. Ensure it is loaded via Expo Google Fonts.
NAVIGATION: Use 4 bottom tabs (Dashboard, Clients, Employees, Settings). Do not exceed 4 tabs. Combine Cleaning/Security under 'Clients' using a top segmented control.
STATUS BADGES: heavily use color-coded chips for status (Active=Success, Expiring=Warning, Expired=Error). Place them prominently on the client/contract cards.
IMAGES WITH TEXT: Any text rendered on top of the dashboard_hero or cover images must use a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) to guarantee contrast.
HAPTICS: Add subtle haptic feedback to the Segmented Controls (Cleaning/Security), FAB taps, and Save/Delete actions.
